I will recount all your wonders.
I will rejoice and exult in you.
I will sing a psalm to your name,
For my enemy will be turned back.
Quoniam fecisti judicium meum et causam meam;
For you have accomplished my judgment
You have sat upon the throne that judges justice.
and the impious one has perished.
You have deleted their name in eternity
The spears of the enemy have failed in the end,
and their cities, you have destroyed.
Their memory has perished with a loud noise.
But the Lord remains in eternity.
He has prepared his throne in judgment.
et ipse judicabit orbem terræ in æquitate:
And he will judge the whole world in equity.
He will judge the people in justice.
Et factus est Dominus refugium pauperi;
And the Lord has become a refuge for the poor,
Et sperent in te qui noverunt nomen tuum,
And may they hope in you, who know your name.
quoniam non dereliquisti quærentes te, Domine.
For you have not abandoned those seeking you, Lord.
Psallite Domino qui habitat in Sion;
Sing a psalm to the Lord, who dwells in Zion.
Announce his study among the Gentiles.
quoniam requirens sanguinem eorum recordatus est;
Because of those who yearned for their blood, he has remembered them.
He has not forgotten the cry of the poor.
vide humilitatem meam de inimicis meis,
See my humiliation from my enemies.
qui exaltas me de portis mortis,
You lift me up from the gates of death,
ut annuntiem omnes laudationes tuas in portis filiæ Sion:
so that I may announce all your praises at the gates of the daughter of Zion.
I will exult in your salvation.
Infixæ sunt gentes in interitu quem fecerunt;
The Gentiles have become trapped in the ruin that they made.
in laqueo isto quem absconderunt comprehensus est pes eorum.
Their foot has been caught in the same snare that they themselves had hidden.
The Lord will be recognized when making judgments.
in operibus manuum suarum comprehensus est peccator.
The sinner has been caught in the works of his own hands. Pause
The sinners will be turned into Hell:
all the Gentiles who have forgotten God.
Quoniam non in finem oblivio erit pauperis;
For the poor will not be forgotten in the end.
patientia pauperum non peribit in finem.
The patience of the poor will not perish in the end.
do not let man be strengthened.
Let the Gentiles be judged in your sight.
so that the Gentiles may know that they are only men.
ut sciant gentes quoniam homines sunt.
O Lord, have you withdrawn far away?
Why have you overlooked us in opportunity, in tribulation?
They are held by the counsels that they devise.
Quoniam laudatur peccator in desideriis animæ suæ,
For the sinner is praised by the desires of his soul,
The sinner has provoked the Lord;
according to the multitude of his wrath,
Non est Deus in conspectu ejus;
God is not before his sight.
inquinatæ sunt viæ illius in omni tempore.
His ways are stained at all times.
Auferuntur judicia tua a facie ejus;
Your judgments are removed from his face.
He will be master of all his enemies.

Non movebor a generatione in generationem,
from generation to generation without evil.”

sub lingua ejus labor et dolor.

inclinabit se, et cadet cum dominatus fuerit pauperum.

quoniam tu laborem et dolorem consideras,

and it will not be found.

You will perish the Gentiles from his land.

præparationem cordis eorum audivit auris tua:
